systems.system: PRODIGY civil-status reform (unique identifier number assigned from birth; central database)
systems.country_label: Projet de Gouvernance Digitale et de Gestion de l'Identité Malagasy (PRODIGY): gestion de l'état civil, numéro d'identifiant unique dès la naissance, base de données centrale
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation, with the Commission Nationale chargée de l'État Civil et de l'Identification (CNECI) steering the reform; World Bank financing

note: Data-protection authority's annual report, cover-dated January 2026. It says PRODIGY, with World Bank financing, is transforming civil-status management by assigning a unique identifier from birth, that the Interior ministry holds a central database, and that CNECI steers civil-status modernisation; it speaks of computerising civil registers as a project CMIL will audit. It never says where or how a birth or death record is made, so no system can be classed civil and no fact is taken.
